title: Add Ask Sage as a new AI provider
author: jdbohrman
lessons: New providers must ADD entries to exhaustive Records/switches, not REPLACE existing provider entries
Provider integration requires a settings UI component (AskSage.tsx) in addition to handler/types/schemas
Default model IDs must be consistent across packages/types and cli/constants
Government/FedRAMP-authorized providers fill a real niche for defense sector users
